headline: Crypto ETFs See $1.8 Billion Net Outflows as Bitcoin Pulls Back to $61,000
summary: Spot cryptocurrency exchange-traded funds recorded $1.8 billion in net weekly capital outflows as Bitcoin declined to around $61,000, dampening institutional investor demand.
why: US-listed crypto ETFs provide institutional exposure to digital assets, making fund flows a major indicator of institutional market sentiment.

impacts.name: Bitcoin
impacts.why: Price declines triggered net redemptions across spot cryptocurrency ETF products.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Sustained price corrections triggered profit-taking and capital withdrawals from digital asset fund products.
